meta.title: Exchange rates
meta.description: Euro foreign exchange reference rates published by the European Central Bank (one rate per working day, around 16:00 CET).

usd_per_eur.source: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates, 2026-09-25
usd_per_eur.definition: US dollars per one euro, ECB daily reference rate (mid-rate based on the daily concertation procedure between central banks). Used to convert all USD figures on this site into EUR and vice versa.
